pages.title: COMART — From Product Concept to Mass Production | ODM / OEM Partner
pages.desc: COMART is an ODM/OEM partner for consumer electronics and automotive accessory brands. One team covers product planning, design, mechanical and electronics engineering, tooling, plastic injection, assembly, testing and supply chain delivery across Taiwan, China and Vietnam.

pages.title: Services — Six Stages from Concept to Mass Production | COMART
pages.desc: COMART's services are organised around your product development process: planning and design, mechanical and electronics engineering, prototyping and tooling, plastic injection, assembly and testing, and supply chain delivery.

pages.title: Product Planning & Design | COMART Services
pages.desc: User scenario and product requirement definition, product planning, industrial design, preliminary material and process advice, target cost and volume feasibility.

pages.title: Mechanical & Electronics Engineering | COMART Services
pages.desc: Mechanical design, material and structure selection, electronic system planning, circuit design, firmware development, test planning, and PCB/PCBA and certification partner management.

pages.title: Prototyping, DFM & Tooling | COMART Services
pages.desc: Appearance and functional prototypes, DFM/DFMA review, mould design, mould flow, parting, gating and ejection planning, T1 trials and mould revision, acceptance and transfer to production.

pages.title: Plastic Injection & Manufacturing | COMART Services
pages.desc: Engineering plastics and elastomers, injection tonnage and part size range, two-shot and over-moulding, process stability and parameter management, pilot run and mass production.

pages.title: Assembly, Testing & Quality | COMART Services
pages.desc: Assembly and packaging, work instructions and process control, functional, reliability and environmental testing, quality inspection and records, third-party laboratory coordination.

pages.title: Supply Chain & Delivery | COMART Services
pages.desc: Material and sub-supplier management, production allocation between China and Vietnam, pilot run to mass production transfer, packaging and shipment coordination, delivery and quality project management.

pages.title: Global Operations — One Team Across Taiwan, China and Vietnam | COMART
pages.desc: COMART operates as one team across Taiwan, China and Vietnam. We propose the production setup based on your product maturity, process, cost, lead time, country of origin and export requirements.

pages.title: Products — Platform Products & Quick Customization | COMART
pages.desc: Two routes to your own product: validated platform products that can be extended or combined, and quick customization of existing products through logo, colour, appearance and packaging.

pages.title: Quality & Compliance | COMART
pages.desc: Control points from incoming material to outgoing shipment, reliability and environmental testing, third-party laboratory coordination, and group-level certifications including ISO 9001, ISO 14001, amfori BSCI, Sedex/SMETA and Apple MFi.

pages.title: Equipment | COMART
pages.desc: COMART's manufacturing, tooling, assembly and testing equipment across our China and Vietnam operations.

pages.title: Company — About COMART, Vision and Milestones | COMART
pages.desc: COMART has been developing and manufacturing consumer electronics and automotive accessories since 1994, with over 200 employees and more than 100 patents granted to date.

pages.title: News — Exhibitions, Capability and Certification Updates | COMART
pages.desc: COMART company news: exhibitions and trade shows, company development, certification updates, new equipment and capacity, and new product releases.

pages.title: Start Your Project | COMART
pages.desc: Tell us where your product stands today. Send us your product stage, application, target market and volume expectation, and we will come back with a development route and the right people from our team.

pages.title: Inquiry | COMART
pages.desc: Start a project with COMART, or email our sales team directly. Choose whichever suits how far your product has progressed.
